sloka: ज्वालामाली स तु शरः क्रव्यादानुगतो रणे ।मुक्तो गुल्मान्द्रुमांश्चापि भस्म कृत्वा प्रधावति ।। ७.२१.४४ ॥
transliteration: jvālāmālī sa tu śaraḥ kravyādānugato raṇe ।mukto gulmāndrumāṁścāpi bhasma kṛtvā pradhāvati ।। 7.21.44 ॥

translations.english: That arrow, wreathed in flames and followed by flesh-eating demons, once released in battle, rushed forward, turning bushes and even trees into ashes.
